purpose: Revised homepage hero options: minimal greenery, open sky, closer back-facing coworkers and a coach leading at the front on a bright office terrace.

images.alt: Quatre collègues vus de dos suivent un coach sur une terrasse de bureaux ouverte sur le ciel.
images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: revised homepage hero photograph for the French workplace movement website Vivimoves.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the previous office terrace photograph. Preserve its natural photographic look, warm pale stone terrace, contemporary office context, inviting soft daylight, realistic scale and anatomy, and wide 16:9 landscape format. Produce ONE standalone photograph, not a collage.
Required changes: radically reduce greenery and bring the participants MUCH CLOSER. Remove the large foreground tree, overhead leaves, all ornamental grasses, lush planting beds, and the background forest. Show an open rooftop office terrace instead, with broad clean beige paving, a simple slender railing and a distant low urban roofline. Pale blue open sky with delicate clouds should occupy roughly the upper 40 percent of the image, unobstructed by foliage. At most one small understated plant at the far edge: greenery less than 5 percent of the image. Keep an office glass facade with discreet desks visible at one edge so this clearly feels like a workplace terrace.
Four adult colleagues are grouped in the middle ground about 5–7 meters from the camera, closer than the reference, full bodies occupying roughly 35–45 percent of image height. ALL FOUR PARTICIPANTS ARE SEEN STRICTLY FROM BEHIND, no turned heads or facial profiles, while performing a gentle synchronized standing stretch. They wear comfortable neutral everyday work clothes, not identical uniforms. Two meters ahead of the group stands ONE clearly distinguished coach, leading the same movement demonstration, separated from participants, in a muted ochre athletic top. The coach is farther from the camera than the participants, at the front of the class. Show the coach from a rear three-quarter angle with the head turned away so no facial features are visible. The participants follow the coach, arms and posture communicate the exercise. Keep all five people naturally separated, feet on the terrace and complete bodies visible.
People should have a gentle optical soft focus, while the bright terrace and office architecture are crisp. No recognizable faces on anyone, no strange smearing, no detailed facial features. Luminous, pleasant and warm, light cream and sand palette with ample sky. No text, logos, watermark, graphics or UI.
Variation 1: camera at normal standing height, straight rear view of four participants loosely arranged in two staggered pairs, with coach visibly ahead in the center. Gentle standing side stretch, one arm overhead. Office glazing at the left edge occupies only a narrow strip; the rest opens broadly toward sky above an unobtrusive urban horizon. Balanced, spacious composition; absolutely no overhead foliage.
